'''''Aspects of the Force, The Light and the Dark''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tasiele Shan]], descendant of the famous [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bastila Shan]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and mother of [[Satele Shan]]. Tasiele was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for challenging the Order's views on attachment and marriage, and when the Order attempted to retrieve her from her exile many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, they found only her cliffside dwelling and a series of journals dedicated to her daughter. The journals were passed to Tasiele's daughter Satele, and Satele&mdash;who later became [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]&mdash;brought ''Aspects of the Force'' with her on her self-imposed exile to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]].<ref name="KOTFE" />
